title: Interesting history; stunning architecture/design
text: Guide "Andy" provided an interesting and informative tour, explaining points of interest (in English and French) and ensuring everyone's comfort and safety. The palace design is fascinating and gorgeous: the tiles, wood carvings, arches, gardens, etc. I feel that I learned so much and enjoyed the experience much more by having a guide.

title: A great experience
text:
We booked an English speaking small tour of the Alhambra and enjoyed our visit. We found our meeting point after going to the wrong place at first - it was easy enough to find with google maps. Booked in, got our numbered stickers and paid an euro each for earphones (we didn’t have any with the right lead/jack) and had a coffee in the cafe while we waited for our guide.
